# Anoop Sinkaran
Blacktown NSW, Australia • 0406 295 160 • ns.anoop@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/anoop-sinkaran

## Executive Summary

Seasoned Senior Quality & Test Automation Lead with over 19 years of experience delivering end-to-end testing strategies, reusable automation capabilities, and quality platform enablement across cloud platforms, mobile applications, and enterprise systems. Proven track record of stepping into technical leadership roles, guiding engineering teams through platform migrations, establishing upstream quality practices, and driving defect prioritization. Google Cloud Generative AI certified expert with extensive experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools, Playwright test automation, and Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines to accelerate software delivery and elevate product reliability.

*   **Automation Frameworks & Testing:** Playwright, TypeScript, JavaScript, Selenium WebDriver, Android Espresso, iOS XCUITest, Robolectric, API & UI Test Automation, Data Integrity Validation
*   **AI-Assisted Quality Engineering:** Custom Copilot SKILL Creation, Copilot CLI, Generative AI Prompting, Automated PR Review Workflows, AI-Driven Test Automation
*   **CI/CD & DevOps Engineering:** Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Slack API Integration, GitHub, UNIX Shell Scripting

*   **Languages & Frameworks:** TypeScript, JavaScript, Kotlin, Python, Java, C#, SQL, .NET, React, Jetpack Compose
*   **Domain Expertise & Observability:** Payment Terminals & Schemes, Digital Wallets, ISO/APACS Standards, Mobile Security Framework (MobSF), Dynatrace
*   **Agile Tooling & Methodologies:** Agile/Scrum, JIRA, Zephyr, TestRail, HP ALM
